title: Quadratic G-BSDEs for bond pricing with endogenous short-rate feedback
abstract: arXiv:2609.19094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study robust bond valuation with endogenous short-rate feedback under volatility uncertainty. Within the $G$-expectation framework, the dependence of the short rate on the bond price yields a nonlinear fixed-point problem, represented by a quadratic $G$-BSDE for the logarithmic price. Under suitable assumptions, we establish existence, uniqueness, comparison, and stability for bounded finite-horizon solutions. An additional strict monotonicity condition yields a unique bounded infinite-horizon solution and exponential convergence of finite-horizon approximations on compact time intervals. We apply these results to inverse short-rate design, constructing discount-rate coefficients that reproduce admissible smooth bond-price targets at a fixed maturity. translated_title: 用于具有内生短期利率反馈的债券定价的二次G-倒向随机微分方程
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在波动率不确定性下具有内生短期利率反馈的稳健债券估值问题。在G-期望框架内，短期利率对债券价格的依赖产生了一个非线性不动点问题，该问题可由对数价格的一个二次G-倒向随机微分方程（G-BSDE）表示。在适当的假设下，我们建立了有界有限期限解的存在性、唯一性、比较原理和稳定性。附加的严格单调性条件进一步给出唯一的有界无限期限解，以及有限期限近似在紧时间区间上的指数收敛性。我们将这些结果应用于逆向短期利率设计，构造贴现率系数，使其在固定期限上再现可容许的光滑债券价格目标。对于长期限情形，我们构造了反馈规则，使得补偿对数价格指数收敛到一个指定的有界状态依赖轮廓，同时渐近（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文在G-期望框架下建立了带内生短期利率反馈的二次G-倒向随机微分方程系统理论，证明了有限与无限期限解的存在性、唯一性与稳定性，并将其应用于逆向短期利率设计和长期限债券价格的反馈规则构造。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the theory of quadratic G-BSDEs with endogenous short-rate feedback under G-expectation, establishing existence, uniqueness, and stability of finite- and infinite-horizon solutions, with applications to inverse short-rate design and feedback rules for long-maturity bond prices.
